creative_direction: Make a ram head from folded ivory paper, with two large orange horns built from fan-like pleats. The muzzle is one angular folded plane, and two small charcoal paper insets give the face a calm proud expression. Let one horn sit slightly higher and curl inward more tightly, creating deliberate asymmetry. Render the paper thickness and a few crease shadows, keeping the face broad and readable rather than highly faceted. Use a flat pale mint background with a soft shadow directly beneath the head. The horn loops form a strong circular silhouette that fits safely within the square avatar. No full body, frame, writing, or additional decorative paper shapes.
